fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 25% health. A lunge at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 18 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Skittish Nip
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 12% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Plunge
fusions.desc: You lurch 2 tiles away and your movement speed rises 30% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flinch-Set Scales
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
